name: Pat Riley
why: His own senior class portrait, and the only photograph of him the digitised volumes carry.
caption_quote: JAMES PATRICK RILEY, Bardstown. Kappa Sigma, pres; Junior Class V-P
how_identified: 1971 Talisman senior grid, printed p. 141 (scan leaf n300). The left column lists seniors in alphabetical blocks of four and the photograph grid runs four to a row in the same order; the block Richardson / Riggins / Riley / Roberts matches row 1 as man, woman, man, man, so Riley is row 1, column 3. His printed entry names the Junior Class Vice Presidency and the Associated Students Judicial Congress, which is the office the worklist gives him for 1969-70.

name: Sue Pritchett
why: Her own senior class portrait; the only other frame of her is a small cheerleader picture.
caption_quote: PEGGY SUE PRITCHETT, Corydon ... Cheerleader ... Junior Class Secretary
how_identified: 1971 Talisman senior grid, printed p. 158 (scan leaf n317). Names run down the left column in alphabetical blocks of four against a four-wide photograph grid in the same order; the block Pritchett / Pruett / Pugh / Pushko matches row 5 as woman, woman, woman, man, so she is row 5, column 1. Her printed entry ends Junior Class Secretary, the office the worklist gives her for 1969-70, and the volume index carries only one Pritchett, Peggy Sue.

name: Terry Hicks
why: His senior class portrait, the only photograph of him the digitised volumes carry.
caption_quote: TERRY M. HICKS, Bowling Green. History. Sophomore Class V-Pres.; Lambda Chi Alpha; IFC.
how_identified: 1971 Talisman senior grid, printed p. 173 (scan leaf n332). Alphabetical blocks of four in the right-hand column run against a four-wide photograph grid in the same order; the block Hendricks / Hendricks / Hensley / Hicks matches row 7 as woman, man, woman, man, so he is row 7, column 4. The printed cell gives Bowling Green and Sophomore Class V-Pres. Both match the contemporaneous roster of the first Congress of Associated Students, which lists him as Terry Hicks, Sophomore, Bowling Green, Sophomore Class Vice President. The volume index carries exactly one Terry Hicks (Hicks, Terry Moss, 114, 173).

name: Judy Beard
why: A working photograph of her at an ASG meeting, and the only frame in the digitised volumes whose caption names her alone.
caption_quote: Judy Beard, a senior math major, glances over her copy.
how_identified: 1980 Talisman, printed p. 275 (scan leaf n278), the small photograph at the head of the Associated Student Government spread. The page carries two photographs and two captions; the first caption, set directly beside this frame, reads REVIEW of the minutes is a part of ASG meetings, and names only Judy Beard. The second caption belongs to the large radio-studio photograph below and names Jamie Hargrove, who is already published from it. Only one person is in focus in the frame.

name: Bill Cortus
why: His own sophomore class portrait. The only other frame of him in the volume, the un-rally photograph on p. 399, is shot from behind and shows no face.
caption_quote: WILLIAM J. CORTUS, East Peoria, Ill.
how_identified: 1977 Talisman, printed p. 389 (scan leaf n392), sophomore class portraits. Names run down the right-hand column in blocks of nine against a nine-wide photograph grid in the same order; Cortus is ninth and last in the first block, so he is row 1, column 9. The block reads Conover, Cook, Cook, Coomer, Cooper, Coots, Cornett, Cornwell, Cortus, that is woman, woman, woman, woman, woman, man, man, woman, man, and row 1 matches it exactly. Row 2 was checked the same way and also matches. The volume's back index carries one Cortus, William James, at pp. 307, 325, 389 and 399, and p. 399 is the rally at which the caption names Bill Cortus.

name: Dianne Batchelor
why: Her freshman class portrait, taken two years before her term. It is the only photograph of her the digitised volumes carry.
how_identified: 1965 Talisman, printed p. 252 (scan leaf n259), freshman class portraits. This volume labels its rows in words: the names are printed at the right under First Row, Second Row and so on, seven names to a row against a seven-wide photograph grid. Batchelor is sixth of the seven names in the Sixth Row, so she is row 6, column 6. The row reads Barton, Basham, Basham, Basham, Baskerville, Batchelor, Bates, that is man, man, woman, man, woman, woman, man, and the sixth row of faces matches it exactly. The volume's back index carries one Batchelor, Dianne Elizabe, at p. 252, and no Talisman from 1971 to 1981 contains the surname at all. A freshman in 1964-65 is a junior in 1966-67, the year the worklist gives her.
